== Overview ==

Server Venerix is an OldSchool 7.4 server featuring the original Real Map, delivering an authentic classic Tibia experience. The gameplay is enhanced with unique custom systems, brand new custom maps, exclusive new items, and many more features. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
